notes.title: BlastBall: All-Stars at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[b]Up to 4 friends [/b]can play Air Hockey, Soccer, Dodgeball, and Tennis in this free demo of [b]BlastBall: All-Stars[/b]! 

No friends around right now? No problem! Just load up a few [b]bots [/b]and jump into practice, quickplay, or set up a tournament as you get a [i]taste of the action[/i].

With simple, intuitive controls, [i]hopping into any sport is easy[/i]. Utilize your blast charges and add spin to your shots to become a real All-Star!

Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230830/BlastBall_AllStars_Demo/]BlastBall: All-Stars demo[/url] and [b]wishlist now[/b]!
Have feedback for us? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/5mmBwer6vs]Discord[/url]!

The full version of BlastBall: All-Stars is expected to be released in [b]Q1 of 2025[/b]. 
Featuring: 
[list]
[*]Soccer
[*]Air Hockey
[*]Gagaball
[*]Royalty
[*]Dodgeball
[*]Knockout
[*]Volleyball
[*]Tennis
[*]Squash
[*]Pickleball
[/list]
There are [b]even more sports[/b], game modes (and secrets) to come. Follow along and have yourself a [b]BLAST[/b]!
